title: An acceptance that runs zero tests must not pass
goal: A GMCP task acceptance named a test filter that matched nothing; cargo exited zero and the precheck treated the task as already delivered, so the orchestrator nearly closed unimplemented work. When the acceptance is a cargo/nextest test command, parse the passed count and refuse an acceptance that ran zero tests, so a typo or a missing test can neither pass a ladder nor close a task.
